queries_run: Eli Lilly largest customer wholesaler McKesson Cencora Cardinal concentration 2026 10-K
Eli Lilly single-source supplier risk customer diversify in-house 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：McKesson、Cencora、Cardinal Health 三家美國批發商在 2023–2025 各占合併營收顯著比例，無其他客戶超過 10%；搜尋未見最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的來源。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, three wholesale distributors in the U.S.—McKesson Corporation, Cencora, Inc., and Cardinal Health, Inc.—each accounted for a significant percentage of our consolidated revenue. No other customer accounted for more than 10 percent of our consolidated revenue in any of these years.

customer_second_source.note: 客戶為通路批發商，無 second-source/in-house 證據；未取得第二供應商相關來源。as_of 為 10-K 約略申報日。
